title: Existence of a single augmented concrete Godement model
statement: For every scheme $X$ and $\mathcal O_X$-module $F$, there exist a cosimplicial object $A$ and a cochain augmentation $a:F[0]\to K(A)$ such that ModuleCupGodementModel $X,F,A,a$ holds [def-sc-module-cup-godement-model] and ModuleCupGodementCodegeneracies $X,F,A$ holds [def-sc-module-cup-godement-codegeneracies]. Here $K(A)$ is the alternating coface complex extended by zero to integer degrees. Thus the terms, cofaces, codegeneracies and degree-zero germ augmentation are all the concrete monad construction. No flasqueness or quasi-isomorphism is asserted.

source.place: Godement resolution, construction preceding Lemma 20.30.1; Banerjee, arXiv:1004.1491, §1.1.4, pp. 15–16.

proof.text: Obtain the prescribed Godement cosimplicial object and its coface/codegeneracy formulas from the cosimplicial realization. Apply the proved augmentation construction to its terms and cofaces. Combine the resulting model with the same term equalities and codegeneracy formulas.

theorem moduleCup_godement_models_exist (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules) :
    ∃ (A : CosimplicialObject X.Modules)
      (a : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).obj F ⟶
        (((alternatingCofaceMapComplex X.Modules).obj A).extend
          ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)),
      ModuleCupGodementModel X F A a ∧ ModuleCupGodementCodegeneracies X F A
